newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Rebels say Bukavu taken, fighting for Goma airport.
newsitem.headline: Rebels say Bukavu taken, fighting for Goma airport.

text.p: Tutsi Banyamulenge rebels said on Thursday they had seized the eastern Zairean city of Bukavu and were fighting for control of the airport in the city of Goma.

"We are in Goma now and our forces are fighting for control of Goma airport. We took Bukavu last night. It is completely under our control," a rebel spokesman told Reuters in the town of Uvira, which was captured by rebel forces nearly a week ago.

Reuters correspondent Buchizya Mseteka said he and another foreign journalist who arrived in Uvira on Thursday were the first to visit the lakeside city since it was seized by rebel forces last Thursday.
As the journalists drove into Uvira in a convoy escorted by Banyamulenge fighters, people cheered at roadsides, he said.

He saw hundreds of refugees, belongings piled on their heads, returning to their homes in the town and thousands of Banyamulenge fighters on the road from the town of Kamanyola near the border with Rwanda to Uvira, facing Burundi across Lake Tanganyika.
